quarterly_data.quarter: Saudi Aramco press release: Remarks by Amin H. Nasser at the 2026 Energy Intelligence (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CEO Amin Nasser (London): the near-closure of the Strait of Hormuz has caused the most serious energy supply shock of his career; nearly 3 billion barrels of gross oil supply have been lost, partly offset by more than 1 billion barrels drawn from stocks, and less than 6 billion barrels of commercial inventories remain, most not practically available; replenishing inventories could take up to two years. Aramco's local supply chain has provided more than 90% of the materials used in asset restoration, and Aramco is studying additional crude export routes and more overseas storage.
quarterly_data.figure: nearly 3 billion barrels lost; less than 6 billion barrels of commercial inventories
